title: One complete transducer round
statement: For every binary string $x$, there is a positive integer $t$ with $t\le 4|x|+5$ such that, starting from the dual transducer's anchor configuration on $x$ with input head at position $1$ and empty output, the configuration after $t$ steps has the same state, head position, and tape contents as the starting configuration, and its output is the guarded dual output of $x$. At every time $j$ with $0<j<t$, the transducer is not in the anchor state.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$, let $c$ be the dual transducer's configuration on $x$ in
the anchor state with input head at position $1$ and empty output. There is a time $t$
with $0 < t \le 4|x| + 5$ such that the configurations at all times $j$ with
$0 < j < t$ are not in the anchor state, and the configuration at time $t$ equals $c$
except that its output is the guarded dual output of $x$: the polarity-flipping scan
of $x$ if $x$ passes the formula syntax scan, and the single bit $0$ otherwise.
